data.source: rules-of-thumb full and null journals; Lichess rated standard 600+0

bootstrap.undefined: omit undefined ratios and count them

readings.population: all inherited rows of the thirteen rules; parenthetical caps do not replace their actual counts
readings.bootstrapPopulation: all retained games of each rule and period; every measure shares those game multiplicities
readings.controlBootstrap: all retained games pooled across the thirteen rules; repeated game rows across rules share a multiplicity
readings.primary: quiet positions with a nonempty safe rule set
readings.allEligible: all positions with a nonempty safe rule set, quiet or not; descriptive only
readings.coverage: quiet divided by all retained rows; nonempty safe rule set among quiet divided by quiet rows; move identity shares within each comparison population
readings.emptySafeRuleSet: counted in coverage, excluded from every move comparison including Ns minus N
readings.splits: lift in quiet eligible positions only; material, phase, Rs capture-or-check, king danger from the check app
readings.controlFailure: no rule receives a verdict; measures remain descriptive
readings.freshBestDifference: first exact line UCI compared with the original first exact line; denominator is positions needing a fresh search
